candidate.description: Test intent also recognizes 'tested' and 'testing'. For a short test search, test hits still go first, but the best source hit moves to second place.
candidate.frozen_before_validation_in: candidate record written after development and before validation

development.questions: Consumed sets only: 2026-10-16-test-intent, 2026-10-16-search-usefulness (development and validation), 2026-10-17-file-coverage (development and validation); 68 questions, 32 with a test word.
development.allowed: Candidate changes are allowed on development data only.

validation_rules: compare(B, T2) passes: no aggregate loss of files or visible quotes at 5, 24 or scoped; no net inspection loss; p95 at most max(0.1 s, 1.5 x B).
Zero individual judged-file or visible-quote losses at 5, 24 and scoped.
Judged files at 5: net gain of at least 2, with gains in at least 2 packs.
Every question without a test word has identical delivery on every page; candidate generation is identical for every question.
development_rules: compare(B, T2) passes on the 68 consumed questions.
Zero individual judged-file or visible-quote losses.
Judged files at 5: net gain of at least 2.
Questions without a test word: identical delivery; generation identical.
acceptance.ranking_gate: The CI ranking gate must pass on the PR if the candidate ships.
acceptance.decision: Ship only if every development and validation rule holds. Validation runs once; no tuning after it.
